note: Juneau County park on the west shore of 16,000-acre Castle Rock Lake, 12 mi north of Mauston: three camping areas in pine woods, with A and C along the shore. Beach, boat launch, disc golf, playgrounds. About 80 sites, mostly in Area B, are held by seasonal campers. --Claude
